steps.title: Extract total RNA with Trizol
steps.instruction: Follow the manufacturer’s Trizol protocol for Marinomonas mediterranea, using 200‑500 µl saturated culture in Marine Broth 2216; avoid column‑based or size‑selective steps.

steps.title: Prepare denaturing 6% PAGE gel
steps.instruction: Assemble a pre‑cast Novex 6 % TBE‑Urea gel (catalog EC6865BOX) in the XCell SureLock Mini‑Cell, remove the gel comb and green tape, fill inner and outer chambers with 1× TBE running buffer (10× TBE diluted), and pre‑run at 180 V for ≥30 min.

steps.title: Prepare RNA samples for loading
steps.instruction: Mix 5‑10 µg total RNA with 0.1 µg Ultra Low Range DNA ladder in 2× formamide gel loading dye to a final 1× concentration; keep total volume <15 µl. Denature at 94 °C for 5 min in a thermocycler with heated lid, then place immediately on an ice‑water slurry.

steps.title: Flush urea from gel wells
steps.instruction: Using a 100 µl pipette, flush each well several times with running buffer from the inner chamber to remove residual urea.

steps.title: Load and run RNA samples
steps.instruction: Load samples with gel‑loading pipette tips, leaving 1‑2 empty lanes between different RNA samples; load ≤4‑5 RNA samples plus one ladder lane in a 10‑lane gel. Run at 180 V until the bromophenol‑blue front (~25 nt) reaches near the gel bottom (≈35 min).

steps.title: Prepare gel‑elution tubes
steps.instruction: Make a cross‑shaped incision at the bottom of a 0.6 ml microcentrifuge tube with a clean razor blade, place the tube inside a 1.5 ml siliconized tube, and keep both caps on.

steps.title: Stain gel with SYBR Gold
steps.instruction: Stain the gel in 1× TBE containing SYBR Gold diluted 1:5,000 (3 µl SYBR Gold in 15 ml buffer) on a rocking nutator for ~5 min at room temperature; wear protective equipment.

steps.title: Excise small‑RNA gel fragments
steps.instruction: Transfer the gel onto clear plastic film, place on a 365 nm UV transilluminator, and excise fragments from the 25‑nt marker up to the 75‑nt marker (just below the bright tRNA band). Place each fragment in a separate prepared elution tube.

steps.title: Pulverize gel fragments
steps.instruction: Centrifuge each elution tube at 20,000 × g, room temperature, for 1‑3 min to force the gel through the incision into the siliconized tube; remove any remaining gel pieces from the 0.6 ml tube with a clean tip and discard the 0.6 ml tube.

steps.title: Elute RNA from gel
steps.instruction: Add 300 µl polyacrylamide gel elution buffer to each 1.5 ml siliconized tube, vortex, freeze at –80 °C, thaw at 37 °C for 2 min, vortex, repeat 2‑3 times, ice 1 min, then incubate at 4 °C with shaking overnight. Briefly centrifuge to collect slurry.

steps.title: Filter and precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Place a 0.45 µm cellulose‑acetate filter in a new siliconized 1.5 ml tube, widen a 1,000 µl tip with scissors, transfer slurry, centrifuge 16,000 × g for 2 min RT, discard filter, add 1 µl (20 mg/ml) glycogen and 1 ml 100 % ethanol, precipitate at –80 °C for 30 min, centrifuge 20,000 × g at 4 °C for 30 min, discard ethanol, wash pellet with 1 ml 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 20,000 × g for 2 min RT, repeat wash, briefly spin, remove residual ethanol with a 10 µl pipette, air‑dry 3 min (flame optional), and resuspend in 17 µl RNase‑free water.

steps.title: PNK treatment of RNA
steps.instruction: Denature RNA at 90 °C for 1 min, ice 1 min. Add 2 µl 10× PNK buffer and 1 µl PNK enzyme to the 17 µl RNA, mix, incubate 37 °C for 1 h. Add 80 µl RNase‑free water, 50 µl 7.5 M ammonium acetate, and 500 µl 100 % ethanol, then precipitate as in the previous precipitation step. Resuspend pellet in 4.5 µl RNase‑free water.

steps.title: 3′ adapter ligation (no ATP)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 4 µl mixture per sample by mixing equal volumes of 5× adenylation buffer and 50 % PEG 8000 (add 20 % extra for pipetting error). Transfer RNA to a 0.2 ml PCR tube, add the 4 µl mixture, vortex, heat 98 °C for 1 min, ice 1 min, cool to RT. Add 0.5 µl (100 µM) pre‑adenylated 3′ adapter oligo and 1 µl T4 RNA ligase I, mix, and incubate at 22 °C for 6 h (or store at 4 °C overnight).

steps.title: Digest excess adapters
steps.instruction: Pre‑mix 78 µl RNase‑free water with 10 µl NEB buffer 2 per sample. Heat RNA at 95 °C for 1 min, cool, add 88 µl buffer mixture, then 1 µl 5′ deadenylase; incubate 30 °C for 30 min. Add 1 µl RecJ f, incubate 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction and precipitation
steps.instruction: Pre‑spin a heavy PhaseLock gel tube at 16,000 × g for 2 min RT. Add 100 µl RNase‑free water to each sample, transfer to the PhaseLock tube, add 200 µl acid‑phenol:chloroform (1:1), shake vigorously, centrifuge 16,000 × g RT 5 min. Add 200 µl chloroform, invert gently, centrifuge 16,000 × g RT 5 min. Transfer aqueous phase to a new siliconized 1.5 ml tube, add 0.5 µl (20 mg/ml) glycogen, 100 µl 7.5 M ammonium acetate, 1 ml 100 % ethanol, precipitate at –80 °C for 30 min, centrifuge 20,000 × g 4 °C 30 min, wash twice with 1 ml 70 % ethanol (centrifuge 20,000 × g 2 min RT each), briefly spin, remove residual ethanol, air‑dry 3 min, and resuspend in 5.75 µl RNase‑free water.

steps.title: Reverse transcription
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix per sample: 2 µl 5× First‑Strand Buffer, 1 µl 0.1 M DTT, 0.5 µl 10 mM dNTPs (+20 % extra). Transfer RNA to a 0.2 ml PCR tube, add 0.25 µl (100 µM) reverse‑transcription primer, heat 90 °C 1 min, ice 1 min, add 3.5 µl master mix, then 0.5 µl SuperScript II RT, mix, incubate 42 °C 30 min. Meanwhile pre‑run a Novex 10 % TBE‑Urea gel at 180 V for ≥30 min. After RT, add 2 µl 1 N NaOH, incubate 70 °C 15 min, then add 12 µl 2× formamide loading dye (final 1×). Prepare 0.1 µg Ultra Low Range DNA ladder in 2× loading dye (final 1×). Denature and run cDNA on the gel, running until the Xylene Cyanol front (~55 nt) reaches near the bottom (45‑60 min).

steps.title: Excise cDNA fragments
steps.instruction: Excise gel fragments corresponding to 100‑160 nt (avoid bright bands >90 nt); use the no‑template control as a guide. Elute cDNA at room temperature, then resuspend the pellet in 17 µl RNase‑free water. Reserve half of the sample and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Circularize cDNA
steps.instruction: To 8 µl cDNA add 1 µl 10× circLigase buffer, 0.5 µl 1 mM ATP, 0.5 µl 50 mM MnCl₂, and 0.5 µl circLigase enzyme; mix and incubate 60 °C 75 min. Prepare 3‑3.5 % agarose gels in 1× TAE with 0.5 µg/ml ethidium bromide (12‑well comb). Stop the ligation by heating 80 °C 15 min. Use the circularized cDNA (ccDNA) directly for PCR.

steps.title: PCR amplification with indexing
steps.instruction: Prepare a PCR mix per sample: 100 µl 2× Phusion Master Mix, 1 µl 100 µM universal primer, 100 µl water. Add 200 µl PCR mix to 5 µl ccDNA, then 1 µl a unique indexing primer. Split into five 0.2 ml PCR tubes (40 µl each). Run PCR with cycle numbers N = 12, 15, 18, 21, 24: 98 °C 30 s; N × [98 °C 10 s, 60 °C 10 s, 72 °C 10 s]; hold 10 °C. Add 8 µl 6× DNA loading dye to each reaction.

steps.title: Select optimal PCR product
steps.instruction: Load all five titrations side‑by‑side on a 1× TAE agarose gel (0.5 µg/lane Ultra Low Range DNA ladder) containing 0.5 µg/ml ethidium bromide; run at 3.6‑3.7 V/cm for 1‑2 h. Visualize at 365 nm, choose the lane with the highest cycle number that still shows a clear band ~50 bp above the bright empty‑ccDNA band (~125 bp). Excise the corresponding gel slice with a pipette tip fitted with gel‑excision tips.

steps.title: Purify PCR amplicon
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from the gel slice using the QIAGEN MinElute Gel Extraction kit, then quantify with the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit. Calculate concentration using: (sample concentration ng/µl) × (average library length bp) × 10⁶ = concentration nM.

steps.title: Pool and sequence libraries
steps.instruction: Pool the purified libraries in equimolar amounts. Submit for Illumina single‑read 80‑cycle sequencing (≈1 million reads per sample for CRISPR RNA analysis).
